historical_record.headline: An ambitious waterfront restaurant from the restaurateurs known for affordable prix-fixe

historical_record.description: The Wharfside Building, once called the China Basin Landing Building, was built in 1922 and altered in 1973 for offices. The city's 1976 survey rated it "1", minor or no importance, and a 1983 Caltrans survey for the I-280 transfer concept found it ineligible for the National Register.
